cite.locator: Budget at a Glance, Transfer of Resources to States and Union Territories with Legislature, row I: Devolution of States share in taxes, Revised Estimates 2025-26 column

notes: 2025-26 is the final year of the Fifteenth Finance Commission's award, so the same horizontal shares apply as in every year since 2021-22. The total is a revised estimate: what states were actually devolved in 2025-26 is not published until the 2027-28 Budget.
